rationale: Independent evaluation of input 'foto sem detalhe legível'. Request better evidence/clarification for an unreadable image, rather than assert that the input is a non-food or invent a meal identity. ADR §16 explicitly defines negative image/label controls; do not infer nutritional provenance, gram amount or a consumed food from an untrusted document. This verifies the semantic oracle's rejection or clarification contract, not any production vision runtime.
